title: Name Puzzle
shareTitle: Name Puzzle 🌈 — Build a Name, Meet a Friend
description: Choose one of 20 familiar four- or five-letter names, match its felt letter tiles to the clue spots, and reveal a unique cozy character friend. A gentle name-recognition game for ages 3–6.
learningGoals: Recognize a familiar written name as a whole
Match uppercase letters to visible letter clues
Practice left-to-right letter order, including repeated letters
interactionModel: tap any matching felt letter tile or drag it directly to its letter-clue spot
feedbackModel: Recorded name prompts, spoken letter sounds, gentle wiggle-and-retry guidance, staged idle hints, and a unique character reveal with a short confetti celebration.

modes.title: Build a Name
modes.skill: name recognition, letter matching, and letter order
